svg.title: The timeline model: tracks, clips as references, and revisions
svg.desc: At the top, a sequence drawn as tracks. One video track, V1, holding three clips laid end to end. One audio track, A1, holding two. A third strip notes that there are up to eight audio tracks in all. Below, three statements. First, a clip is a reference: it names an asset with in and out points, and the source is never modified or copied. Second, the rules: clips on one track never overlap, and sound never runs past the picture. Third, every edit is a patch: it writes a new revision, and undo writes an old one forward rather than rewinding, so nothing is lost by undoing.
svg.text: up to eight audio tracks in all
it names an asset, with in and out points
the source is never modified and never copied
clips on one track never overlap
and sound never runs past the picture
it writes a new revision, and undo writes an old one
forward rather than rewinding, so nothing is lost
